name: SwatchPicker
description:
One colour from a small set (a palette, an organisation's tint): round swatches in a
recessed track, each named by a tooltip. The chosen swatch takes an accent ring. Arrow
keys move between swatches; the group is one tab stop. In a SettingRow the row's label
names it, like a segmented control.

Container-aware (R7), like Segmented: when the swatches do not fit the box it is given,
the track holds one button showing the chosen swatch and a chevron, whose menu lists every
swatch with its name and a check on the chosen one. The button keeps its width whatever
the value. The value, onValueChange and the group's accessible name are the same in both
forms.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ options, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, size, collapse: collapseProp, disabled, onBlur, className, id, ...aria }: SwatchPickerProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: collapse
props.description:
What happens when the swatches do not fit: "auto" (default) folds to one menu button
showing the chosen swatch; "menu" always shows it; "none" wraps the swatches. Default:
the host's SegmentedCollapseContext, else "auto".

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called with the focus event when focus leaves the whole picker, not when it moves between swatches. For form libraries' touched state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen swatch's `value` when the person picks one (a swatch, or a menu item in the menu form); pressing the current swatch does not deselect it. Pair with `value` to control it.

props.name: options
props.description: The available choices, including their values and visible labels.

props.name: size
props.description: sm 32 for toolbars, md 40 beside fields and segmented controls (default).

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen swatch. `null` when none is (a custom colour is in use).
